timer_bug: profile_premium_render.gd reads draw/setup counters without ever setting profile_draws=true; counters stay zero by construction. Its idle/frozen workload also misses ordinary moving terrain rebuild cost.
observed_bottleneck: Measured renderer/driver work is about 18-19 ms median, versus 1.86 ms mean terrain-section setup and 0.091 ms mean draw callbacks. Setup is real but cannot alone recover minimum 50 FPS from this 36 FPS run.
new_bounded_lead: Camera-only invalidation currently triggers each 8 world pixels although _draw_partitioned_deep consumes clamped integer first/last tile bounds (64 px tiles). A tool-only proof could skip camera-only reconfiguration while those exact bounds, viewport and zoom are unchanged, retaining every existing terrain/mining/pet/direct-restore/rebase invalidation. This differs from rejected light receiver/support caches and already-adopted local strip revisions / station-only redraw. No such candidate was implemented or adopted here.
lead_limit: 884 setup-only frames do not prove all of their 2.09 seconds removable. Some may hide/reorder cached items or update material state; no cause-level probes were added. Approx 0.963 ms/frame is opportunity size, not a measured optimization benefit. Even all 1.86 ms/frame setup elimination is inadequate as a 50 FPS solution.
monitor_limit: Performance.TIME_PROCESS and TIME_PHYSICS_PROCESS yielded just 61 distinct values across 2169 samples and repeated unchanged for up to 41 frames. Their sampled p95/p99 is not a true per-frame CPU percentile, and report serialization/capture spikes can be repeated in those monitor samples. Use chronological wall frame intervals and explicit draw timers for this diagnosis.
other_limits: Linux Mesa llvmpipe at 1696x780; not Apple GPU or physical iPhone.
One diagnostic run; timers and observer enabled, no new A/B performance claim.
Observer costs about 47.5 us/frame excluding JSON serialization and PNG capture; every workload frame includes their overhead.
Viewport render CPU, GPU, engine process/physics monitor and frame setup are not disjoint timings to add together.
